messages.subject: The format problem of output files in .csv format
parts:
Hi group,

I used the example R script to analyze the data and got all the output files as expected.

The only problem is that the generated output files in .csv format did not have all the values in the different columns; instead, the data for each row was all in the first column (as shown below), which means some extra steps are needed to split a single column of text into multiple columns.



Is there a reason why the dataset is not in order? What can be done to fix it?

Thanks!

messages.author: c2b608cf1a4e77a3
messages.subject: Re: The format problem of output files in .csv format
parts:
Hi Zoe,
Your data is in the CSV (Comma Separated Values) format and you want it to be in XLSX (excel table format).
Try searching for "csv to xlsx". It is a simple process and there are several tutorials available.

Best,
Marcus
